quote:

quote: ## read as endearing, apparently, which is the most dangerous kind of

quote: ## **Opening up is a decision, and it was being made for everybody.**

quote:
## **Static because it is a rule, not a state.** It was five lines inside

quote: ## The bands overlap on purpose. A roll is continuous, and a stage that waits
why: Eighteen lines (1235-1252) teaching the technique of a rolling receive, of which one sentence is a decision -- the smoothstep bands overlap. The "previous version" paragraph names 112 degrees but measures nothing, so it is a war story rather than archaeology.

quote:

quote:
## How high off the floor counts as airborne, in normalised elevation.
##
## Above the noise that a settling interpolation puts on a grounded player, and
## well below the elevation any real jump reaches.
const AIRBORNE_ELEVATION: float = 0.14
const GROUNDED_ELEVATION: float = 0.03
why: This asserts the threshold sits between two distributions without giving either -- no noise amplitude, no jump elevation, no sample. That is the failure mode FAILURE_MODES.md is named for, in a comment that sounds like it was measured. `GROUNDED_ELEVATION` gets no justification at all despite being the other half of the hysteresis.
suggestion: Give the measured noise floor and the lowest observed jump elevation, or say plainly that both numbers were picked by eye.

quote:
## Deliberately *observed* rather than announced. The actor is handed elevation

quote: func set_pose(

quote: ## is not zero, because a nobody stands with their arms locked straight. The

quote: ## Correct-then-clobbered, and the third time in this file: something builds

quote: ## has them cocked behind the head. Those are not stylings, they are how you

quote:

quote:

quote:

quote:

quote:
## How decisively the block has to beat the swing for each outcome.
##
## Re-derived twice. At -0.06 and -0.24 the block touched 82% of all attacks and

why: Two complete multi-paragraph doc blocks sit back to back documenting the same three constants (BLOCK_STUFF/TOUCH/FUNNEL_MARGIN), the second opening with its own heading and its own derivation. The first is superseded prose that was never deleted, so the constant carries forty lines of comment where roughly twelve are current.

quote:
## rolling instead of swinging. The block is the fourth contact that needs it and

quote:
## How much of the absorption band each intent commands. A soft block is the

why: Same defect, worse placement: the absorption-band comment sits directly above `BLOCK_CLOSE_DEFICIT_SHARE`, which is a different quantity, while the constants it describes are two lines further down. The two doc blocks are concatenated with no separator, so Godot attaches both to the wrong symbol.

quote:
## What a defender brings to a dig, as a fraction of an ideal one. Sums to 1.0

It is also orphaned -- the DIG_*_WEIGHT constants it describes are fifty lines below at 617.

quote:
## **Funnelling has never bought the diggers anything, which is the whole point
## of funnelling.** A block told to funnel gives the line and channels the ball
## into the middle, so the defence behind it knows where to be -- and until now
## the intent moved only the wall's own position, so choosing it was a decision

why: An aphorism in bold ("which is the whole point of funnelling"), then a rhetorical closer about "the six people it was made on behalf of". Three read-bonus constants are declared underneath (0.075, -0.030, 0.090) with no derivation, no distribution, no measured dig-rate change -- exactly what the house style says a claim of significance owes.
suggestion: State what the three bonuses were sized against and what the dig rate did; drop the bolded claim.

quote:
## How much the attacker is favoured when swing and dig are equally good. A
## clean swing beats a set defence more often than not, so an even contest is
## not a coin flip.

## floor and 82% of them came up. A clean swing beating a set defence should not
## be the exception, and at 0.09 an even contest was close to a coin flip on a

why: Thirty-eight lines of comment for one float, made of at least four superseded strata stacked on top of each other (0.20, then 0.09, then +0.07, then -0.14, then -0.04). The first two paragraphs argue for a *positive* advantage that the constant below now contradicts, so a reader who stops early is actively misinformed.
suggestion: Keep only the current derivation: the sign argument, the -0.517/+0.468 dig-margin distribution, and why -0.14 was rejected. Cut the superseded strata.

quote:
## Named for what it is now rather than for what it was. As

quote:
## **Raised from 0.90 with the ball's new pace.** One defender is still not a
## whole defence and this still says so; what changed underneath is that a spike
## now arrives at up to 28 m/s where it used to arrive at 18, and the floor

why: Opens by restating the previous block's first sentence verbatim in spirit ("One defender is not a whole defence" -> "One defender is still not a whole defence and this still says so"), and closes on "a defence a viewer can be proud of", which is taste asserted where the 12%/11% figures had already made the case.
suggestion: Drop the restatement and the closing clause; the two dug percentages and the 0.96-double-counting note are the whole argument.

quote: ## FLAGGED. These four bound every setter's tempo and are now load-bearing:
why: A process marker plus a seventeen-line design essay ending "So the work here is a lift/double-contact outcome driven by `setting_technique` against the release the situation demands, not a better constant." That is a backlog item, addressed to whoever schedules work rather than to whoever reads these four floats.

quote:
## evidence, the rollout audit and the progression calibration. Three consumers,

why: A rhetorical closer restating the sentence before it for effect. The useful content -- that this is read from the shadow setter's own decision rather than inferred from pass quality -- is already in the first sentence of the block.

quote:

quote:

quote:
attack_rollout = RallyRolloutPolicyModel.select_attack_source(
				shadow_summary, lineup, false
			)
			selected_live_attack = {}
			using_live_attack = false

Any future change to the promotion protocol has to be made in four places correctly.

quote:

quote:

quote:

quote:
## Only swings that ended the rally teach anything. A ball that was dug is
	## neither a spot that worked nor one that did not -- counting it as a failure

quote:

quote:

quote:

quote:

quote:
